overall: The AG found the Fall River Community Development Agency is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it lacks a fixed multi-member structure that acts by quorum vote, so it could not violate the notice requirement.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Agency failed to post notice of its January 7, 2015 annual HUD hearing as required by the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Though several individuals work for the Agency, it is not a multiple member body empowered to act collectively because it does not have a fixed membership requiring a vote by a quorum of members in order to make decisions and conduct business.
